description: This Java class defines the 'CloseConnection' command, which is used to close a specific 'Connection' in the system. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, serializing to JSON, and retrieving connection identifiers, as well as annotations for immutability and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CloseConnection
classes.description: An immutable command class representing a request to close a specific connection, including JSON serialization/deserialization and connection ID management.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of CloseConnection with the specified connection ID and headers.

methods.description: Parses a CloseConnection command from a JSON string or object, associating it with the provided headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the connection ID into a JSON payload, considering the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the connection this command targets.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for this command resource.

methods.description: Returns a new instance of CloseConnection with the specified headers.
